page.overview:
Who is Edgar Adley?

Edgar Adley was a wizard who lived in the late 19th century.

He operated a stall as a vendor in Aranshire in 1890. He and his friend Milo had the idea of making lots of money from selling Acromantula venom extracted from live Acromantulas. However, they were both overwhelmed in one of the spider's nests in the Forbidden Forest and Edgar watched as his friend died. Before Milo died, he asked Edgar to take his heirloom pocket watch to give to his daughter to remember him by, but Edgar fled in terror before he could take it, later it was found by a Hogwarts student.
